method: Built-in image_gen, individual transparent frames; supplied scene PNGs copied unchanged
shared: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE premium dimensional illustrated circular scene FRAME OVERLAY, square PNG, genuinely transparent background AND transparent empty center. Front-on, concentric opening exactly centered at 50%,50%. Continuous opaque circular inner rim radius 35% of canvas width. All ornaments on ring between radii 35% and 48%, with no intrusions into the empty opening. Full frame visible with margin; no cropping. No scene in center, no background, no text, no watermark, no checkerboard. Detailed polished collectible artwork matching a Disney-inspired scene. Design:

frames.name: Disney • Imperial Dragon Palace
frames.design: Crimson lacquer and carved gold Chinese dragon rim, jade accents, blue pagoda roof tiles and miniature amber palace lanterns.

frames.name: Disney • Mickey's Toontown
frames.design: Whimsical pink turquoise yellow enamel, tiny striped shop awnings and flower boxes, black mouse-ear medallion and red bow at top. Playful polished theme park craftsmanship.

frames.name: Disney • A Bug's Life Meadow
frames.design: Interwoven oversized blades of grass and clover leaves, tiny dewdrop gems, dandelions, purple flowers, one little friendly blue ant ornament on outer rim.

frames.name: Disney • Sugar Rush Kingdom
frames.design: Candy cane striped ring, pink icing, glossy chocolate, rainbow sprinkles, tiny lollipops and sugar gumdrops. Candy racing kingdom palette.

frames.name: Disney • Zootopia Skyline
frames.design: Sleek gold and teal futuristic city ring, tiny yellow monorail around outer edge, snow crystal and sandstone accents, small rabbit and fox silhouette medallion at top.

frames.name: Disney • Brave Highland Castle
frames.design: Weathered Scottish castle stone, moss, intricate bronze Celtic knots, purple heather and small turquoise wisp jewels. Refined medieval collectible.

frames.name: Disney • Encanto Casita
frames.design: Terracotta roof tiles, warm ochre and pink stucco details, lush magenta bougainvillea and green vines, golden butterfly ornaments, tiny amber lanterns.

frames.name: Disney • Element City
frames.design: Four elements ring: sculpted amber flames on left, translucent blue water on right, emerald leaves below and pearly cloud curls above, polished copper bridges.

frames.name: Disney • Castle Fireworks
frames.design: Royal blue and gold fairytale rim, small pink castle spire at top, sculpted magenta violet gold firework starbursts attached to outer ring, warm lantern gems.

frames.name: Disney • Moonlit Galleon Harbor
frames.design: Rich dark ship timber and braided nautical ropes, brass compass medallion, ivory sail curls, warm hanging lanterns, sapphire wave trim. No skulls.

frames.name: Disney • WALL-E Sunset Wasteland
frames.design: Rusty copper and weathered yellow industrial metal hoop, rivets gears and stacked compacted scrap cubes on outer rim, warm amber sun jewel and tiny green seedling accent.

frames.name: Disney • Adventureland Falls
frames.design: Carved sandstone temple ornament, braided rope bridges, palm leaves and bright hibiscus flowers, turquoise waterfall glass flowing around the lower rim, warm lanterns.
